# Structured Design Review

## Review status

**Ready for implementation**

No Critical or High blockers remain. Medium findings were resolved in `architecture.md`.

## Executive summary

Hari-Agents is correctly designed as one static HTML page plus a same-folder CSS file under `plans/hari-agents/`. That matches the approved spec: title and one `h1` exactly `Hari-Agents`, greeting with Welcome and Hari-Agents, personal-agent-workspace tagline, no forms, no analytics, no backend, no SPA. Repo-root `requirements.md` (`US-LOGO-1`) stays out of scope.

The Proposed draft was implementable in outline but had Medium gaps: no viewport meta (FR-11), page JavaScript not explicitly banned, test file drawn inside the runtime trust boundary, a Mermaid `--` alias risk, remote URLs only implied, and contrast stated as ratios without default tokens. Those are now decided. Open copy/visual questions stay non-blocking with defaults.

## Findings

| ID | Severity | Category | Finding | Impact | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-1 | Medium | Requirements / a11y | HTML contract omitted viewport meta. | ~375×667 (FR-11) may not use the intended CSS width. | Add `width=device-width` viewport meta. **Done (AD-11).** |
| F-2 | Medium | Security | Only third-party/analytics scripts were banned. | First-party JS could add unused attack and scope surface. | Forbid all `<script>` in `index.html`. **Done (AD-10).** |
| F-3 | Medium | Diagrams | Context diagram put `welcome-page.test.mjs` in the runtime trust boundary. | Test file looked like a visitor asset. | Split runtime files vs verification artifacts. **Done.** |
| F-4 | Medium | Diagrams | Sequence alias `node --test` uses Mermaid `--`. | Diagram may fail to render. | Rename to `node test runner`. **Done.** |
| F-5 | Medium | Security / FR-8 | Remote `href`/`src` were not banned in the HTML contract. | A CDN font or image could create a tracking surface. | Allow only same-folder `styles.css`. **Done.** |
| F-6 | Medium | Technology / NFR-1 | Contrast ratios had no default tokens. | Implementers could pick failing gray. | Default `#ffffff` / `#1a1a1a`. **Done (AD-12).** |
| F-7 | Low | Diagrams | Implementer visual-check path was text-only. | Context diagram understated visual NFR checks. | Add Implementer → Browser. **Done.** |
| F-8 | Low | Open decisions | Req Q-4 (later multi-page) was unlisted. | Later scope creep less explicit. | OD-6: this release is one page. **Done.** |

**Critical:** none. **High:** none.

## Requirement coverage

| Requirement | Covered? | Architecture evidence | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-1 Title exactly `Hari-Agents` | Yes | C-PAGE `<title>`; C-TEST | None |
| FR-2 Visible heading name `Hari-Agents` | Yes | Single visible `h1`; C-STYLE must not hide it | None |
| FR-3 Greeting with Welcome and Hari-Agents | Yes | Default `Welcome to Hari-Agents` in `main` | None (OD-1 default) |
| FR-4 Personal agent workspace line | Yes | Default `A personal agent workspace.` | None (OD-1 default) |
| FR-5 First viewport; no click/form/API | Yes | Content in `main`; CSS for ~1280×800 | None |
| FR-6 Static files; no backend | Yes | HTML+CSS; `file://` or optional static serve | None |
| FR-7 No input collection | Yes | No `form`; C-TEST | None |
| FR-8 No analytics/telemetry | Yes | No scripts, no remote URLs; C-TEST | None (closed by F-2/F-5) |
| FR-9 Single semantic `h1` | Yes | Exactly one `h1`; C-TEST | None |
| FR-10 Readable contrast / NFR-1 | Yes | AD-12 `#ffffff` / `#1a1a1a`; visual verify | Visual check remains (by design) |
| FR-11 ~1280×800 and ~375×667 | Yes | Viewport meta + fluid wrap; visual verify of wrap | Visual wrap check remains |
| FR-12 Text identity if image fails | Yes | Text wordmark; no required image (AD-4) | None |
| NFR-2 Chromium static open | Yes | §9.1 file-open success mode | None |
| NFR-3 Stack is architecture choice | Yes | AD-1 HTML/CSS; SPA rejected | None |
| Out of scope (auth, APIs, Jira-in-page, SPA, `US-LOGO-1`) | Yes | §1.3, §14; no components | None |

## Assumptions requiring validation

These do not change the architecture if the defaults stay accepted:

- **A-3 / A-4:** Greeting `Welcome to Hari-Agents` and tagline `A personal agent workspace.`
- **A-5:** First browser target is current desktop Chrome or Edge
- **A-6 / A-7:** English only; light theme; no dark-mode toggle
- **A-8:** Text wordmark is enough; no logo artwork
- **A-9:** Root `requirements.md` remains the unrelated `US-LOGO-1` draft
- **AD-12:** `#ffffff` / `#1a1a1a` is a contrast default, not approved brand colors

None of these reopen product scope.

## Open decisions

| ID | Decision | Blocking? | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| OD-1 | Exact greeting/tagline | No | Assumed copy above |
| OD-2 | Separate app repo vs this folder | No | `plans/hari-agents/` |
| OD-3 | Decorative mark besides text | No | Text-only |
| OD-4 | Visual direction beyond readable light UI | No | System fonts + AD-12 |
| OD-5 | Optional static server vs `file://` | No | `file://` is enough |
| OD-6 | Later multi-page workspace | No | One static page this release |

**Blocking open decisions:** none.

## Diagram consistency

After the edit:

- Context diagram: runtime trust boundary is only `index.html` + `styles.css`; test file is “not served”; Implementer opens Browser and Node
- Component diagram: visitor runtime vs implementer verification; no backend
- Visitor sequence: local HTML then same-folder CSS; no API
- Test sequence: `node test runner` alias (no `--`); string asserts only
- Text, catalog (C-PAGE, C-STYLE, C-TEST, C-BROWSER, C-RUNNER), and diagrams match

No remaining contradictory or missing diagram elements for this scope.

## Recommended architecture updates

Applied in this review (no further architecture edit required):

- Document status → Approved / Passed / Yes
- AD-10, AD-11, AD-12
- §2.5–2.6 trust wording and context diagram
- C-PAGE / C-STYLE / C-TEST contracts
- Mermaid aliases
- §7.1 HTML contract (charset, viewport, no script, no remote URLs)
- §8 security; §9.2 a11y; §10 risks/OD-6; §11 FR map; §13 pipeline; §15 findings

## Changes made to architecture.md

- **Document status:** Proposed → Approved; Design review Passed; Ready for implementation Yes; review date 2026-10-05
- **§1.3 / §3 / §1.5:** tighter trust boundary; AD-10–AD-12
- **§2.5–2.6:** runtime vs verification; Implementer → Browser
- **§4.1–4.3:** viewport, no JS, default palette, stronger test asserts

- No Critical/High architecture blockers
